phishing_red_flags: Requires registration fee via UPI / QR code
Asks for Aadhaar OTP directly over WhatsApp / Telegram
Promises instant cash credit without documentary verification
Uses non .gov.in / non .nic.in domain posing as government portal
Claims lottery or prize under PM welfare scheme
Requests bank debit card PIN or CVV for subsidy disbursement
statutory_rti_exemptions_sec8: 8(1)(g) - Endangerment of life and physical safety of any person
8(1)(h) - Impeding investigation or prosecution of offenders
8(1)(j) - Personal information with no relationship to public activity
